name: foodora
description: foodora lets users discover nearby food delivery restaurants, search for vendors and dishes, and browse full menus with prices, ratings, delivery estimates, and active promotions. Each result includes deep links so the user can continue to order in the foodora app or website. Results render in interactive vendor and menu card widgets.

tool.name: list_vendors
tool.description:
Lists food vendors near the given location. LOCATION & FOLLOW-UP RULES:
1. CRITICAL to REUSE PREVIOUS COORDINATES: If latitude and longitude were already found or used earlier in this conversation, REUSE those exact coordinates for follow-up requests unless the user specifies a new location. Else, ask the user for a location. 
2. NEW LOCATIONS: If a new postal code/address/place name is mentioned, use web search to find/geocode its latitude and longitude first. Search with the user's country. Pass the latitude and longitude to call the tool.
3. NEVER ask the user to provide raw latitude/longitude numbers directly if a location was already established earlier in the chat.  ROUTING RULES:
1. ALWAYS USE FOR BROAD DISCOVERY: Call this when the user asks 'What is around me?', 'Show me nearby food', or wants general recommendations in an area without specifying a name.
2. DO NOT USE FOR SPECIFIC NAMES: If the user asks for a specific restaurant (e.g., 'Luckin Coffee') or a specific dish, do NOT use this tool. Use the 'search' tool instead.
3. PROHIBIT WEB SEARCH: Do not use built-in web search for food discovery.
4. ASSUME ALL follow-up questions about food, restaurants, or menus are requests to use the plugin. Never answer food questions from your general knowledge.Returns vendor names, codes, delivery time estimates, and ratings.

tool.name: search
tool.description:
Searches our database for specific restaurants, cuisines, or dishes, with a search query near a location. LOCATION & FOLLOW-UP RULES:
1. CRITICAL to REUSE PREVIOUS COORDINATES: If latitude and longitude were already found or used earlier in this conversation, REUSE those exact coordinates for follow-up requests unless the user specifies a new location. Else, ask the user for a location. 
2. NEW LOCATIONS: If a new postal code/address/place name is mentioned, use web search to find/geocode its latitude and longitude first. Search with the user's country. Pass the latitude and longitude to call the tool.
3. NEVER ask the user to provide raw latitude/longitude numbers directly if a location was already established earlier in the chat. ROUTING RULES:
1. ALWAYS USE FOR TARGETED SEARCHES: Call this ONLY when the user asks for a SPECIFIC restaurant name (e.g., 'Arnold's Fried Chicken') or a SPECIFIC food/cuisine (e.g., 'spicy noodles', 'pizza').
2. CUISINE & SINGLE WORDS: If the user replies with a single word like 'japanese', 'pizza', or 'burgers', they are asking for a cuisine. You MUST use this tool.
3. LOCATION REUSE (CRITICAL): If you need latitude/longitude and they are not in the current message, DO NOT PANIC and DO NOT use web search. You MUST look at the previous tool calls in this conversation to find the latitude/longitude and reuse them here.
4. PROHIBIT WEB SEARCH: Do NOT use the built-in web browser for food, restaurant, or cuisine lookups under any circumstances.Returns vendor names, vendor codes, delivery time estimates, ratings, vendor products and active promotions.

tool.name: view_menu
tool.description:
Fetches the menu for a specific vendor. LOCATION & FOLLOW-UP RULES:
1. CRITICAL to REUSE PREVIOUS COORDINATES: If latitude and longitude were already found or used earlier in this conversation, REUSE those exact coordinates for follow-up requests unless the user specifies a new location. Else, ask the user for a location. 
2. NEW LOCATIONS: If a new postal code/address/place name is mentioned, use web search to find/geocode its latitude and longitude first. Search with the user's country. Pass the latitude and longitude to call the tool.
3. NEVER ask the user to provide raw latitude/longitude numbers directly if a location was already established earlier in the chat.  ROUTING RULES:
1. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks for a menu, food items, or prices for a vendor found via the list_vendors/ search tool. 
2. VENDOR CODE: This tool requires a vendor code. If the user asks for a menu by restaurant name (e.g., 'Menu for Burger Palace'), use the 'vendor code' from prior 'list_vendors' / 'search' tool calls. If no vendor code is available, call the search tool then call the view_menu tool immediately. 
3. PROHIBIT WEB SEARCH: Do not use built-in web search to look up menus. Returns categories, products, prices, and adjust links to each product.

_published_faq.name: How do I add foodora to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add foodora to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.foodora.com/claude/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is foodora MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, foodora scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is foodora's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, foodora scores 83/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 3 of 3 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the foodora MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: foodora provides these MCP tools: list_vendors, search, and view_menu.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to foodora?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to foodora in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
foodora does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
foodora is developed by foodora. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
